labels.title: Label
labels.$comment: label associated to the instance of the peripheral, can be overridden at sample level. In this case it becomes read-only.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Generate or not the FDCAN init code, and call it or not at boot
init_type.$comment: Generate the init code of your FDCAN or not (enabled/disabled), call it automatically at startup or not (called/enabled)

fdcan_kernel_clock.title: FDCAN kernel clock frequency
fdcan_kernel_clock.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree

auto_retransmission.description: Automatic retransmission of frames that have lost arbitration or been disturbed by errors during transmission.

transmit_pause.description: When enabled, the peripheral pauses for two CAN bit times after successfully transmitting a message before starting the next transmission.

protocol_exception.description:
When enabled, this causes the operation state to change from Receiver state to Sync state at the next sample point.
When disabled, a recessive "res." bit is treated as a form error, and the FDCAN responds with an error frame.

std_filters_nbr.title: Standard Filter Number
std_filters_nbr.description: Specifies the number of standard Message ID filters.

ext_filters_nbr.title: Extended filter number
ext_filters_nbr.description: Specifies the number of extended Message ID filters.

filter_standard.title: Standard frame filters
filter_standard.source: Array.from({ length: $Main.frame_filters.std_filters_nbr}, (_, i) => ({ id: ('Standard Filter' + i ) }))

oneOf.title: Classic filter: ID1 = filter, ID2 = mask
Dual ID filter. Matches only ID1 or ID2
Range filter from ID1 to ID2
Store in Rx FIFO 0 if filter matches
Store in Rx FIFO 1 if filter matches
Set high priority if filter matches
Set high priority and store in FIFO 0 if filter matches
Set high priority and store in FIFO 1 if filter matches

filter_id1.title: Filter ID1
filter_id1.description:
Specifies the filter ID1.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 0x7FF.

filter_id2.title: Filter ID2
filter_id2.description:
Specifies the filter ID2.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 0x7FF.

actions.message: The filter ID2 must be higher or equal to filter ID1.

filter_extended.title: Extended frame filters
filter_extended.source: Array.from({ length: $Main.frame_filters.ext_filters_nbr}, (_, i) => ({ id: ('Extended filter' + i ) }))

oneOf.title: Classic filter: ID1 = filter, ID2 = mask
Dual ID filter. Matches only ID1 or ID2
Range filter from ID1 to ID2, extended ID AND mask (XIDAM) is applied
Range filter from ID1 to ID2, extended ID AND mask (XIDAM) not applied
Store in Rx FIFO 0 if filter matches
Store in Rx FIFO 1 if filter matches
Set high priority if filter matches
Set high priority and store in FIFO 0 if filter matches
Set high priority and store in FIFO 1 if filter matches

filter_id1.title: Filter ID1
filter_id1.description:
Specifies the filter ID1.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 0x1FFFFFF.

filter_id2.title: Filter ID2
filter_id2.description:
Specifies the filter ID2.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 0x1FFFFFF.

actions.message: The filter ID2 must be higher or equal to filter ID1.

global_filter_config.title: Acceptance or rejection rules for filters
global_filter_config.description: Frame acceptance or rejection rules for the defined filters.

acceptance_non_matching_std.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for the standard frames that did not match the defined filters.

oneOf.title: Accept non-matching frames in Rx FIFO 0
Accept non-matching frames in Rx FIFO 1

actions.message: No standard filters configured and non-matching frames acceptance is set to REJECT. This will reject all standard frames.

acceptance_non_matching_ext.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for the extended frames that did not match the defined filters.

oneOf.title: Accept non-matching frames in Rx FIFO 0
Accept non-matching frames in Rx FIFO 1

actions.message: No extended filters configured and non-matching frames acceptance is set to REJECT. This will reject all extended frames.

acceptance_remote_std.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for all standard remote frames.

acceptance_remote_ext.description: Acceptance or rejection rules for all extended remote frames.

clock_divider.description: Kernel clock divider. Can only be modified by the first FDCAN instance.

fdcan_clk.description: The FDCAN clock frequency after the main clock divider

nominal_prescaler.description:
Specifies the value by which the kernel clock is divided for generating the nominal bit time quanta.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 512

nominal_time_seg1.description:
Specifies the number of nominal time quanta in Bit Segment 1.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 256

nominal_time_seg2.description:
Specifies the number of nominal time quanta in Bit Segment 2.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 128

nominal_jump_width.title: Nominal Sync Jump Width
nominal_jump_width.description:
Specifies the maximum number of nominal time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a data bit to perform resynchronization.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 128.

nominal_bitrate.title: Nominal bitrate
nominal_bitrate.description: Output bitrate for the nominal phase in kbps.

nominal_sample_point.title: Nominal sample point
nominal_sample_point.description: Specifies the location of the sample point in the nominal bit time segment.

data_prescaler.description:
Specifies the value by which the oscillator frequency is divided for generating the Data bit time quanta.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 32

data_time_seg1.description:
Specifies the number of data time quanta in Bit Segment 1.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 32

data_time_seg2.description:
Specifies the number of data time quanta in Bit Segment 2.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 16

data_jump_width.title: Data Sync Jump Width
data_jump_width.description:
Specifies the maximum number of data time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a data bit to perform resynchronization.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 16.

data_bitrate.title: Data bitrate
data_bitrate.description: Output bitrate for the data phase in kbps.

data_sample_point.title: Data sample point
data_sample_point.description: Specifies the location of the sample point in the data bit time segment.

tx_delay_comp_offset.title: Offset
tx_delay_comp_offset.description:
Offset value defining the distance between the measured delay from FDCAN_TX to FDCAN_RX and the secondary sample point.
This parameter must be a number between 0 and 127 mtq (minimum time quantum).

tx_delay_comp_win_length.title: Window length
tx_delay_comp_win_length.description:
Specifies the maximum number of time quanta the FDCAN hardware is allowed to lengthen or shorten a bit to perform resynchronization.
This parameter must be a number between 1 and 128 mtq.

EnableTimeoutCounter.description: 16-bit timeout counter to signal timeout conditions for Rx FIFO 0, Rx FIFO 1, and the Tx event FIFO.

oneOf.title: Timeout controlled by Tx Event FIFO

timeout_period.title: Timeout period
timeout_period.description: Start value of the timeout counter (down-counter). Configures the timeout period.

timestamp_prescaler.title: Timestamp prescaler
timestamp_prescaler.description: Configures the timestamp counter time unit in multiples of CAN bit times.
